title: Ask for the first case study
summary: The founder's case-study request, honestly: the publication rule as the section's one big claim, the status said once (none has cleared), and one email field whose outlined submit opens the visitor's mail app with a request to audit@kelwin.co filled in; nothing is stored.
story: The hinge between the specimen and the ask. Having seen the document, the sceptic learns why no real one is shown and how to get the first one that clears; the red audit button comes after, in the close.

reference.site: GoNimbly (one field, large labels) · the kit's Contact form
reference.borrowed: A single large field beside the lede, one 56px outlined action.
reference.kelwin: The kit's .ac-field (18px label, 22px input on a 64px row) and .ac-btn-o--lg; no window chrome, no mono keys, no red (the page's red is the close's).

motion: entrance: the kit's claim head (label, claim, lede), then the form rises once (420ms).
interaction: submit builds mailto:audit@kelwin.co?subject=Case study request with a two-line body and says so in a status line; without script the form's own mailto action does the same.
copy: [N] label “Published work” · claim (h2) “Every case study waits for the client’s yes.”
[N] lede “None has cleared yet. We’ll email the first one, when a client clears it, to anyone who asks.” (Q2: none publishable; the one status line on the page)

[N] field “Your work email” (placeholder name@company.com) · submit “Send me the first one” · support “It opens in your own mail app, addressed to audit@kelwin.co ↗” (the address ends the line, so the ↗ ends it too; address: the one every form uses; founder to confirm the mailbox)
phone: ≤1023: the form drops under the lede (cols 1–9). ≤767: full width, the submit spans the column. Checked at 834 / 390 / 320.
notes: Replaces round 8's four-row publication spec list and its status chip. No ruled seam: paper → graphite is its own cut. The id km-reports-publishing-S-ask is the head action's target.
